title: Steganography: hidden data in images
description: LSB in pixels, JPEG COM segments, data past a PNG's IEND: three ways to hide and three to find.

1.title: LSB in BMP and JPEG COM

steganography-t01-q01.prompt: Download bmp-lago.bmp from the lab. The first 32 pixel LSBs hold the length (little-endian) then the message. Submit the flag.

steganography-t01-q02.prompt: Download vacaciones.jpg. The flag lives in a JPEG COM (comment) segment. Submit it.

2.title: Data past IEND and double files

steganography-t02-q01.prompt: logo-corp.png is a valid PNG BUT weighs more than it should: a ZIP is glued after IEND. Extract its contents and submit the flag.

steganography-t02-q02.prompt: What hexadecimal signature marks the end of a PNG (the chunk after which the file should end)? Write the 4 ASCII characters.
